cohort: 240 live newborns admitted to the NICU of two tertiary care hospitals in Rawalpindi, Pakistan, between March 25 and April 2, 2019.
finding: Preterm neonates were more likely to experience asphyxia, low birth weight, infections, and jaundice compared to full-term infants.
birth_weight: Mean birth weight 2.1 kg +/- 0.80; 51.7% low birth weight, 26.7% very low birth weight
